scope_note: The party site's copy of the party organ 公明新聞's detailed report (issue of 8 November 1998) of the founding national convention of the new 公明党. The page does not print the convention's day.

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The report says the new-party preparatory office reported that 公明's expanded central committee formally decided the new party name 「公明党」 and its rules on 24 October ('十月二十四日の公明拡大中央委員会で新党名「公明党」と、規約を正式決定').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says the new party was formed by 新党平和 dissolving and merging with 公明 as the surviving party ('新党平和が解散し、公明を存続政党として合流する形式').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says the convention, choosing officers without a ballot (rule 20(2)), which under rule 20(3) needs the confidence of a majority of the delegates present, approved by a show of hands the headquarters officers proposed by the preparatory committee, among them 神崎代表 and 浜四津代表代行 ('神崎代表、浜四津代表代行…本部役員三十七名が挙手多数で信任された').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ's report of 8 November 1998 names 神崎代表 giving the new officers' address after the vote, resolved to fulfil his duties with all his being ('全身全霊をもって職務を全うしていく決意').
